pattern: うちに入らない（うちにはいらない）
purpose: Dismiss something as too small to count as a category.
keywords: N + のうちに入らない; V plain + うちに入らない
Rain this light hardly counts as rain.
Reading it once hardly counts as studying.
Washing one plate hardly counts as helping.
formation: N + のうちに入らない; V plain + うちに入らない
restrictions: Often downplays an amount of work, difficulty, or experience.
mistake: It excludes by a standard, not by physical entry.
